title: John Lennon, George Harrison and Ringo Starr file appeal against High Court ruling | 1971
content:
During the verdict of Paul McCartney’s successful lawsuit to have The Beatles’ business partnership dissolved, John Lennon, George Harrison, and Ringo Starr were given one week to file an appeal.

Solicitors working on their behalf and Apple Corps filed the appeal on 19 March 1971, but it was dropped on 26 April in favour of a negotiation of McCartney’s exit from the partnership.
